title: if Inside Loops
goal: In this lesson you will learn how to put an if statement inside a loop so each value can be checked and handled differently.
learn: Put if inside a for or while loop
Test the current loop value each pass
Indent if under the loop, and its body under if
idea: Loops and decisions work great together. On every trip through the loop, you can ask a question about the current value. Write the loop first, then indent an if inside it. The if body needs another level of indentation. That way only matching values get the special print or action.
changeOneLine: In the editor above, change range(1, 8) to range(1, 5). Press Run. You should only see lines for 1 through 4.

practice.text: Loop from 1 to 10. Print Buzz when n is divisible by 5; otherwise print n.
practice.hint: When n % 5 == 0, print a word like "Buzz". In the else branch, print the number n itself.
practice.starterTip: Try print("Buzz") in the if block and print(n) in the else block. Keep both indented under if/else.
practice.gradingNote: Pass if multiples of 5 print Buzz (or similar) and other numbers print themselves.

practice.text: Loop through temps. Print Hot if a temp is greater than 80, else print OK.
practice.hint: Use the variable t from the loop. The if branch is for temps above 80; the else branch covers the rest.
practice.starterTip: Try print("Hot") when t > 80 and print("OK") in the else. Use quotes around the words you print.
practice.gradingNote: Pass if temps over 80 print Hot (or similar) and others print OK (or similar).

quiz.question: Why put if inside a loop?

options.text: To check a condition on each value

quiz.correct: Each pass can test the current value and decide what to do.
quiz.wrong: if inside a loop lets you decide what to do for each item.

quiz.question: In for n in range(1, 5): then if n % 2 == 0:, when does the if run?

options.text: Once per loop pass, for the current n
Never. If cannot be inside for

quiz.correct: Each time the loop runs, the if checks that pass’s n.
quiz.wrong: The if is inside the loop body, so it runs every pass.

quiz.question: How should indentation look for if inside a loop?

options.text: if and loop at the same indent; no extra indent
if indented under the loop; its body indented under if

quiz.correct: Loop body is indented; if body is indented one more level.
quiz.wrong: Python uses indentation to show loop and if blocks.

project.title: Even Spotter
project.desc: Loop from 1 to 12. If n is even, print Even: n. If n is odd, print Odd: n.
